description:
Why roadsurfer?

  • TEAM SPIRIT & TEAM EVENTS: Look forward to a collegial atmosphere with flat hierarchies, lots of fun and great team spirit, as well as regular team events such as joint sports sessions, pizza & beer evenings, etc.

  • PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT: We support your personal and professional development through an individual Growth Plan and our Inhouse Academy

  • CAMPER BUDGET: You get an annual camper budget to experience the #happyroadsurfing lifestyle for yourself

Keep 4,000+ campers on the road

As Head of Fleet Operations DACH, you make sure our fleet is ready when our guests are. You lead our 5 Regional Fleet Managers and, through them, fleet managers, technicians and damage experts at 40+ stations in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. You report to the Business Director DACH and are part of the DACH leadership team.

What you'll find: a fast-growing company, a young and motivated team and a lot still to build. Not every process exists yet – you'll create many of them. If you need a fully structured environment to perform, this probably isn't for you.

The role – your passion

  • Own vehicle availability, repair turnaround, cost and quality across the DACH market.

  • Own the budget for maintenance, repair and fleet transfers.

  • Build and steer our network of internal and external workshops and service partners.

  • Decide on repair strategies and keep spare parts and workshop capacity flowing.

  • Lead and develop your Regional Fleet Managers and raise the bar for the teams at our stations.

  • Steer by KPIs (repair cost, turnaround time, availability, damage detection) and drive improvements.

  • Work hand in hand with the Regional Operations Managers, who own the stations' P&L.

Where you might come from

You don't need a background in camper or car rental. You might be leading fleet or field operations at a mobility scale-up (car sharing, e-bikes, scooters), a service organisation with technicians on the road (solar, heat pumps, charging, elevators, medtech), or maintenance operations for trains or aircraft. What matters: you've kept a distributed fleet running – availability, repair turnaround, cost – and built the team and partner network to do it.

What you need to surf the wave with us

  • A technical background, e.g. an apprenticeship or degree in a technical field, or hands-on experience running maintenance and repair operations.

  • 5+ years running operations for a distributed fleet or technical field organisation, ideally in a fast-growing environment.

  • Experience leading leaders and getting things done in a matrix.

  • You've built or scaled something before – a team, a process, a partner network.

  • Data-driven and comfortable owning a budget.

  • Hands-on when it counts, with the big picture across 40+ stations in view.

  • Clear, direct communication that gets teams and stakeholders on board.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to our stations and partners across DACH.

  • Fluent German and good working English.

Ready to surf?

You’re perfect for the job? Then we look forward to receiving your application! If you have any questions, feel free to contact us anytime at team@roadsurfer.com, and we’ll get back to you as quickly as possible.

ABOUT #ROADSURFER

We are more than Europe's largest campervan rental company. In 2021 we launched our platform roadsurfer spots in addition to our other products rent, abo and sales – a platform where you can discover and book unique camping spots. But that’s only the beginning. We are growing fast, so hop on board and join us on our journey. The roadsurfer philosophy is simple: rent an RV, start your adventure, be happy. Come ride the wave with us!
